subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: Should the Models card ship with exact-name cross-provider totals that intentionally preserve every provider source, or should Scope B wait for a canonical identity and double-counting policy?
rationale: The code can mechanically preserve or filter records, but only maintainers can decide what a cross-provider aggregate is permitted to mean for users and whether the present no-deduplication disclosure is sufficient.

options.title: Ship the conservative contract
options.body: Approve exact normalized-name aggregation with visible source provenance and no deduplication, then fix the Kimi parser before merge.

options.title: Defer cross-provider totals
options.body: Keep provider-scoped model history and postpone cross-provider totals until canonical identity and duplicate-reporting rules are defined.

options.title: Define canonical mapping first
options.body: Require a maintained mapping or exclusion policy before presenting any cross-provider combined totals.

recommendation.title: Ship the conservative contract
recommendation.body: Approve exact normalized-name aggregation with visible source provenance and no deduplication, then fix the Kimi parser before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level feature and product-surface decision tied to the open feature discussion.
